art.label: Custom art
art.blurb: Painted or imported art from your art packs.

ai.label: Generated art
ai.blurb: Made for the game with an image generator or a script (the replacement pack, the small Heavenly sprites, the wall hangings), not from your own art packs.

3d.label: Textured 3D
3d.blurb: A three.js model with image textures, live in the game or baked to sprites.

flat3d.label: Untextured 3D
flat3d.blurb: A three.js model with flat or procedural colours only, no image textures.

recolor.label: Recoloured / borrowed
recolor.blurb: Uses art made for something else, recoloured or reused.

ascii.label: ASCII pixel art
ascii.blurb: Tiny pixel art typed as text in src/gfx/pixelart.js.

code.label: Drawn in code
code.blurb: Shapes, gradients and particles drawn by code, no art file.

none.label: No art yet
none.blurb: Not drawn at all yet, or shown with a generic stand-in.

sections.name: Monsters & Bosses
sections.blurb: Every monster and boss look: the painted enemy sets, the area rosters, raid bosses and Velscour, and the few foes still on stand-in art. Levels recolour these looks with palette swaps.

sections.name: Heroes & Armor
sections.blurb: The 16 classes: menu portraits, the Grim Nocturne armors and helmets they wear in play, and what the hero still lacks.

sections.name: Summons & Pets
sections.blurb: Everything the classes call up: animated pets, the Slime Lord's court, 3D turrets and companions, and the class signatures still drawn in code.

sections.name: Townsfolk & NPCs
sections.blurb: The people and animals of Herrington Hollow and the road, the vendors, Homunculus the blacksmith, and the gilded critters.

sections.name: Items & Loot
sections.blurb: Bag and ground icons: gems, rings, gold, globes, potions, chests and the generic item icons, plus the loot still drawn in code.

sections.name: Held Weapons
sections.blurb: Every weapon and off-hand in a hero's fist: 35 sets of 50 three.js designs baked to sprites and textured from the material library, the Death Knight's greatsword models, and the painted Paladin pack.

sections.name: Spells, Effects & Icons
sections.blurb: Skill icons, spell effects, gore and the class effect art. Most spell effects and every skill icon are still drawn in code.

sections.name: Environments & Textures
sections.blurb: Dungeon biomes, overworlds and their tile packs, the 3D scenes and ships, and the texture library the 3D models are painted with.

sections.name: Interface
sections.blurb: The HUD, buttons, logo and credits, and the parts of the interface that are still CSS and code.
